fact: The Plan National du Numérique says the government defined a sector policy document (Document de Politique Sectorielle, DPS) for telecommunications and ICT in 2009, referenced in its bibliography as dated July 2009.

The Plan National du Numérique says the DPS lapsed on expiry of its five-year period without the review being carried out; the end year 2014 is five years from the 2009 adoption, the document giving no year.
COPIREP states that the telecommunications sector policy document was approved by the Government; the page gives no approval date, so the date is the document's published year, 2009.

On 23 October 2009 the minister of Posts, Telephones and Telecommunications presented the sector policy document at a workshop that the World Bank director described as finalising the strategy; the article says the sector is about to have the document.
system: Document de politique sectorielle des télécommunications et des TIC

fact: The policy sets targets for 2015 of 33 million fixed and mobile lines (40% teledensity against about 10%) and at least 5% internet access against 1%, per the minister; no cost of the plan is given.
